1.title: Initials (声母 - Shēngmǔ): 21 Basic Consonants
1.description: Learn the 21 initial consonants in Mandarin Chinese classified by articulation organs (lips, tongue, palate).

2.title: Finals (韵母 - Yùnmǔ): 36 Simple & Compound Vowels
2.description: Learn the 6 basic simple vowels, compound vowels, nasal vowels, and retroflex vowels (erhua).

3.title: 4 Intonation Tones (四声 - Sìshēng) & 5-Scale Tone Contours
3.description: Understand acoustic tone contours: Tone 1 (55 High Level), Tone 2 (35 Rising), Tone 3 (214 Falling-Rising), Tone 4 (51 Steep Falling), and Light Tone (Neutral).

4.title: Tone Change Rules (变调 - Tone Sandhi)
4.description: Absolute rules for natural tone changes in conversation: Double Tone 3 (3+3 -> 2+3), changes for the word 不 (bù), and changes for the word 一 (yī).

5.title: Minimal Pairs Discrimination Exercises
5.description: Train your ear to distinguish critical phoneme pairs often confused by Indonesian speakers (b vs p, d vs t, z vs c, zh vs ch).

6.title: Hanzi Anatomy & 7 Stroke Order Rules (笔画与笔顺)
6.description: Master the 8 basic Hanzi strokes (横, 竖, 撇, 捺, 点, 提, 折, 钩) and the 7 standard rules for character stroke order in Mi Zi Ge grids.

dialogue: Hello! Today we will learn "你".
Alright Xiao Mochi, I really want to learn 你!
Look, "好" is very frequently used in sentences.
I understand, thank you Xiao Mochi!

quiz.prompt: Arrange the following words into the correct sentence order:
quiz.explanation: Mandarin follows the order: Subject + [Time] + [Place] + Verb + Object.

quiz.prompt: Fill in the blank of the following sentence with the appropriate word:
quiz.explanation: The choice '你' precisely fills the verb predicate position according to the rule: Subject (我们) + Place (在学校) + Verb (你) + Object (好).
quiz.reasoning: Check sentence structure -> Place the verb after the place phrase -> Eliminate choices that pile up particles

你在.whyFails: Placing the location particle '在' after the verb '你'. In Mandarin, place adjuncts must precede the main verb.
你在.misconception: Placing the location adjunct after the verb (Postverbal Locative Error)

在你了.whyFails: Overusing the aspect particle '了' in habitual sentences. The particle '了' is not a pure past tense marker, but rather an aspect of completion/change of state.
在你了.misconception: Excessive use of the aspect particle '了' (Aspect Redundancy)

你着过.whyFails: Combining the continuous particle '着' with the experiential particle '过'. These two particles contradict each other and should not be used together.
你着过.misconception: Accumulation of conflicting aspect markers (Conflicting Aspect Markers)

在离婚了.whyFails: Excessively inserting the aspect particle '了' in habitual sentences. The particle '了' is not a pure past tense marker but an aspect of completion/change of state.

离婚着过.whyFails: Combining the continuous aspect particle '着' with the experiential aspect particle '过'. These two particles negate each other and should not be used together.
离婚着过.misconception: Stacking conflicting aspect particles (Conflicting Aspect Markers)

qs.stem: What animal does this text talk about?
qs.why: The text mentions 我家有一只小狗 (My family has a little dog).

qs.stem: What is the little dog's name?
qs.why: Its name is 球球 (Qiu-qiu).

qs.stem: When does the author feed their dog?
qs.why: 每天早上 (Every morning).

rzh0002.title: 周末去北京 (Weekend Trip to Beijing)

qs.stem: How did the author travel to Beijing?
qs.why: 坐高铁 (Take the high-speed rail).

qs.stem: How long was the journey to Beijing?
qs.why: 两个小时就到了 (Arrived in just two hours).

qs.stem: What local specialty food did they try?
qs.why: 北京烤鸭 (Beijing roast duck).

qs.stem: Besides lifestyle habits, what does drinking tea in China reflect?
qs.why: 更是一种传统文化 (It is even more of a traditional culture).

qs.stem: Which of the following types of tea is mentioned in the text, EXCEPT:
qs.why: The text mentions 绿茶 (green), 红茶 (black), and 乌龙茶 (Oolong).

qs.stem: What benefits of drinking tea are mentioned?
qs.why: 喝茶能让人静心，也能促进健康。

rzh0004.title: 互联网与移动支付 (Internet & Mobile Payment)

qs.stem: What is the main impact of smartphone popularity in the text?
qs.why: 彻底改变了人们的消费模式。

qs.stem: How do people pay when shopping according to the text?
qs.why: 扫码支付就能轻松完成。

rzh0005.title: 成语里的哲学智慧 (Philosophical Wisdom in Chengyu)

qs.stem: What is the core lesson of the proverb “塞翁失马，焉知非福”?
options: Do not keep horses at the border
qs.why: 祸福相依、凡事不可只看表面的辩证法则。 (The dialectical principle that fortune and misfortune are interdependent, and one should not judge things solely by their surface.)

qs.stem: According to the text, why is understanding Chengyu important?
options: As a way to understand the values of Chinese thought and culture
To do business in a traditional market
qs.why: 是领悟中华思想精神的必由之路。 (It is the essential path to grasping the spirit of Chinese thought.)

rzh0006.title: 我的朋友大卫 (My Friend David)

qs.stem: Where is David currently studying Mandarin?
qs.why: The text states 大卫现在在北京学习汉语 (David is currently studying Mandarin in Beijing).

qs.stem: What drink does David like?
qs.why: The text mentions 大卫喜欢喝中国茶 (David likes to drink Chinese tea).

qs.stem: Where do the author and David often go together?
qs.why: The text states 我们常常一起去图书馆看书 (We often go to the library together to read books).

qs.stem: How many family members are there in Xiao Wang's house?
qs.why: The text mentions 小王家有四口人 (There are four people in Xiao Wang's family).

qs.stem: Where does Xiao Wang's father work?
qs.why: The text states 爸爸是老师，在学校工作 (Father is a teacher and works at a school).

qs.stem: What is Xiao Wang's mother's profession?
qs.why: The text mentions 妈妈是医生 (Mother is a doctor).

rzh0008.title: 去商店买水果 (Going to the Store to Buy Fruit)

qs.stem: How much does one jin (catty) of apples cost?
qs.why: The text mentions 苹果一斤五块钱 (Apples are five yuan per jin).

qs.stem: When did the author and their mother go to the store?
qs.why: The text mentions 今天下午 (This afternoon).

qs.stem: How many jin of apples did mother buy?
qs.why: The text mentions 妈妈买了三斤苹果 (Mother bought three jin of apples).

qs.stem: What time does the author wake up on Sunday?
qs.why: The text states 早上八点我起床 (I wake up at 8:00 AM).

qs.stem: What sport does the author play in the park?
qs.why: The text mentions 下午我们去公园踢足球 (In the afternoon we go to the park to play soccer).

qs.stem: With whom does the author do homework at home?
qs.why: 和哥哥在家里做作业 (Doing homework at home with older brother).

qs.stem: What food does the author think is very delicious?
qs.why: The text mentions 北京烤鸭很好吃 (Beijing roast duck is very delicious).

qs.stem: With whom does the author eat at the restaurant?
qs.why: 我和朋友去一家中国饭馆 (I go to a Chinese restaurant with a friend).

qs.stem: How is the waiter's attitude at the restaurant?
qs.why: 服务员很客气 (The waiter is very polite and friendly).

qs.stem: Where does Li Yue want to go?
qs.why: 李月要去火车站 (Li Yue wants to go to the train station).

qs.stem: What vehicle does Li Yue take?
qs.why: 坐了一辆出租车 (Took a taxi).

qs.stem: How long does the trip take to the destination?
qs.why: 二十分钟后到了 (Arrived after twenty minutes).

qs.stem: What color is the author's watch?
qs.why: 这块黑色的手表 (This black watch).

qs.stem: Who gave the birthday gift?
qs.why: 妈妈送给我的生日礼物 (A birthday gift given to me by mother).

qs.stem: How is the timekeeping of the watch?
qs.why: 走得很准 (It runs very accurately/on time).

qs.stem: How is the weather in Beijing tomorrow?
qs.why: 明天北京会下雨，天气很冷 (Tomorrow in Beijing it will rain, the weather is very cold).

qs.stem: What is the maximum temperature tomorrow?
qs.why: 最高气温只有十度 (The maximum temperature is only 10 degrees).

qs.stem: What item did the teacher remind everyone to bring tomorrow?
qs.why: 出门要带雨伞 (When going out, you must bring an umbrella).

qs.stem: What is the author's older brother's biggest hobby?
qs.why: 最大的爱好是听音乐 (His biggest hobby is listening to music).

qs.stem: When does the older brother usually listen to music?
qs.why: 做完功课以后 (After finishing homework).

qs.stem: How long does the older brother listen to music every night?
qs.why: 听半个小时 (Listen for half an hour).

rzh0015.title: 我的小猫咪咪 (My kitten Mimi)

qs.stem: What color is Mimi the cat's fur?
qs.why: 全身都是黄色的毛 (The whole body has yellow fur).

qs.stem: What drink does Mimi like the most?
qs.why: 它最喜欢喝牛奶 (It likes drinking milk the most).

qs.stem: Where does Mimi usually like to sleep?
qs.why: 在沙发上睡觉 (Sleeping on the sofa).

rzh0016.title: 打篮球的快乐 (The Joy of Playing Basketball)

qs.stem: When does Zhang Ming usually make time to play basketball?
qs.why: 每个周末都会抽出两个小时 (Every weekend he sets aside two hours).

qs.stem: Besides physical training, what is the benefit of sports according to Zhang Ming?
qs.why: 还能放松心情 (It can also relax the mind).

qs.stem: Who does Zhang Ming play basketball with?
qs.why: 和同学打篮球 (Playing basketball with classmates).

rzh0017.title: 去医院看病 (Going to the Hospital)

qs.stem: What symptoms did Xiao Li experience yesterday morning?
qs.why: 觉得头疼、喉咙痛，还发烧了 (Feeling dizzy, having a sore throat, and also having a fever).

qs.stem: What diagnosis did the doctor give to Xiao Li?
qs.why: 医生检查后说他是感冒了 (After examining, the doctor said he caught a cold).

qs.stem: What advice did the doctor give besides taking medicine on time?
qs.why: 需要按时吃药并多喝水 (Need to take medicine regularly and drink plenty of water).

rzh0018.title: 乘坐高铁去上海 (Taking the High-Speed Rail to Shanghai)

qs.stem: How long is the high-speed train journey from Beijing to Shanghai?
qs.why: 高铁只用了四个半小时 (The high-speed rail only took four and a half hours).

qs.stem: What free facilities are provided inside the train carriage?
qs.why: 提供免费的无线网络 (Providing free wireless internet).

qs.stem: What is the approximate travel distance from Beijing to Shanghai mentioned in the text?
qs.why: 一千三百多公里 (More than one thousand three hundred kilometers).

rzh0019.title: 网上购物体验 (Online Shopping Experience)

qs.stem: What item did Lin Na buy online yesterday?
qs.why: 买了一双运动鞋 (Bought a pair of sports shoes).

qs.stem: How long did it take for Lin Na's ordered package to arrive home?
qs.why: 昨天买了，今天下午就送到了 (Bought yesterday, delivered this afternoon).

qs.stem: What convenience is provided if the item size does not fit?
options: Can be returned unconditionally within 7 days
qs.why: 可以七天无理由退货 (Can return within 7 days for no reason).

rzh0020.title: 绿色出行保护环境 (Green Travel to Protect the Environment)

qs.stem: Why do many residents choose shared rental bicycles or the MRT?
qs.why: 为了减少城市空气污染 (To reduce urban air pollution).

qs.stem: What immediate benefit do residents feel when commuting to work?
qs.why: 避免早晚高峰的路上堵车 (Avoiding road traffic jams during morning and evening rush hours).

qs.stem: What movement does this text invite readers to support?
qs.why: 绿色出行 (Green travel).

qs.stem: How many floors does the university library building have?
qs.why: 一栋五层高的白色大楼 (A five-story white building).

qs.stem: What facilities are located on the first floor?
options: Book borrowing hall & digital reading room
qs.why: 借还书大厅和电子阅览室 (Book borrowing/returning hall and electronic reading room).

qs.stem: When do students most crowdedly arrive early in the morning to find a spot?
qs.why: 每到期末考试周 (Every time final exam week arrives).

qs.stem: How old was Li Hua, whose birthday was celebrated yesterday?
qs.why: 李华的二十岁生日 (Li Hua's 20th birthday).

qs.stem: What gift did his friends give to Li Hua?
qs.why: 一本精美的相册 (A beautiful photo album).

qs.stem: What was Li Hua's emotional reaction when receiving the surprise?
qs.why: 感动得流下了眼泪 (Moved to tears).

rzh0023.title: 学做麻婆豆腐 (Learning to Cook Mapo Tofu)

qs.stem: Which regional cuisine did Aunt Chen teach?
qs.why: 地道的四川麻婆豆腐 (Authentic Sichuan Mapo Tofu).

qs.stem: What is the final seasoning sprinkled on before the dish is served?
qs.why: 撒上一层花椒粉 (Sprinkling a layer of huajiao powder).

qs.stem: What is the flavor sensation of this Mapo Tofu dish?
qs.why: 又麻又辣 (Numbing and spicy).

rzh0024.title: 游览故宫 (Touring the Forbidden City)

qs.stem: What is another name for the Forbidden City Palace in Beijing?
qs.why: 又叫紫禁城 (Also called the Forbidden City / Zijincheng).

qs.stem: This royal palace was used during which dynasties?
qs.why: 中国明清两代的皇家宫殿 (Imperial palaces of the Ming and Qing dynasties in China).

qs.stem: What are the characteristic colors of the walls and tiles that make up its grandeur?
options: Red walls and golden-yellow glazed tiles
qs.why: 红色的高墙、金黄色的琉璃瓦 (Red high walls and golden-yellow glazed tiles).

qs.stem: When is the best time to see the red maple leaves at Fragrant Hills (Xiangshan)?
qs.why: 每年十月和十一月 (Every October and November).

qs.stem: What turns a fiery red during autumn?
qs.why: 香山上的枫叶也都渐渐变成了火红色 (The maple leaves on Xiangshan gradually turn fiery red).

qs.stem: According to the text, what is the autumn weather condition like in Beijing?
options: Clear skies and comfortably cool air
qs.why: 天高气爽、气温宜人 (High clear skies, crisp air, and pleasant temperatures).

rzh0026.title: 移动支付的普及 (The popularity of mobile payments)

qs.stem: What is the primary tool people use when paying for purchases?
qs.why: 只需要用智能手机扫描二维码 (Only need to use a smartphone to scan a QR code).

qs.stem: What is the main impact of the popularity of mobile payments?
options: Transaction efficiency increases drastically & lifestyles change
Paper currency is banned from circulation
qs.why: 极大提高了交易效率，也改变了人们的生活方式 (Greatly improved transaction efficiency and changed people's lifestyles).

qs.stem: Do roadside food stalls also accept QR payments?
qs.why: 在路边摊买一套煎饼也能轻松完成付款 (Buying a jianbing at a roadside stall can also easily complete the payment).

rzh0027.title: 熬夜的危害 (The dangers of staying up late on health)

qs.stem: What are the long-term negative effects of the habit of staying up late?
options: Decreased immunity & increased risk of cardiovascular disease
qs.why: 免疫力下降、记忆力减退，还会显著增加心血管疾病风险 (Decreased immunity, memory loss, and a significant increase in the risk of cardiovascular disease).

qs.stem: What is the duration of quality sleep recommended by experts for adults?
qs.why: 保证七到八小时的高质量睡眠 (Ensure 7 to 8 hours of high-quality sleep).

qs.stem: According to the first paragraph, what factors often cause young people to stay up late?
options: Study/work pressure & playing on mobile phones
qs.why: 学业与职场压力，熬夜刷手机或加班 (Study and career pressure, staying up late scrolling on phones or working overtime).

rzh0028.title: 端午节吃粽子 (Dragon Boat Festival and eating Zongzi)

qs.stem: When is the Dragon Boat Festival celebrated according to the lunar calendar?
qs.why: 农历五月初五 (the 5th day of the 5th lunar month).

qs.stem: Which historical figure is most popularly commemorated during this festival?
qs.why: 纪念两千多年前投江殉国的爱国诗人屈原 (commemorating the patriotic poet Qu Yuan, who drowned himself in the river over two thousand years ago).

qs.stem: How do the flavor profiles of zongzi fillings differ between the northern and southern regions?
options: Southern is sweet, northern is savory
Southern is savory, northern is sweet
Southern is spicy, northern is sour
qs.why: 粽子的馅料南方偏甜北方偏咸 (southern zongzi fillings tend to be sweet, while northern ones tend to be savory).

rzh0029.title: 自主学习与终身成长 (Autonomous Learning & Lifelong Growth)

qs.stem: What is the primary differentiating factor among individuals in the information age?
options: The continuous ability and drive for self-directed learning
The number of social media followers
qs.why: 是否具备持续学习的自主驱动力 (whether one possesses the autonomous driving force for continuous learning).

qs.stem: What digital media are mentioned as helping people learn at their own pace?
qs.why: 网课、电子书和播客 (online courses, e-books, and podcasts).

qs.stem: Why are lifelong learners more competitive in the future?
options: Because they do not need to work
Because they are more adaptive and competitive in facing changes
Because they have many displayed degrees
Because they cannot be replaced by computers
qs.why: 终身学习者往往在变化莫测的未来更具竞争力 (lifelong learners tend to be more competitive in an unpredictable future).

rzh0030.title: 垃圾分类新风尚 (New Trend of Garbage Sorting)

qs.stem: How many categories of garbage sorting are implemented in major Chinese cities?
qs.why: 分为四类：可回收物、有害垃圾、厨余垃圾和其他垃圾 (divided into four categories: recyclables, hazardous waste, kitchen/food waste, and other waste).

qs.stem: What type of waste do leftover food and fruit peels belong to?
qs.why: 厨余垃圾 (kitchen/food waste).

qs.stem: What is the attitude of citizens after this system has been running for some time?
options: It has become a consciously practiced civilized habit
qs.why: 已成为公民自觉的文明习惯 (it has become a self-conscious civilized habit of citizens).

rzh0031.title: 志愿者的奉献精神 (The Dedication Spirit of Volunteers)

qs.stem: Where did the young volunteers go last weekend?
qs.why: 前往养老院开展慰问活动 (went to the nursing home to conduct sympathy and visit activities).

qs.stem: What activities did the volunteers do together with the elderly?
options: Cleaning, chatting and listening to stories, and singing
qs.why: 打扫房间、陪聊倾听故事、表演合唱 (cleaning rooms, accompanying them to chat and listen to stories, and performing chorus singing).

qs.stem: How did the volunteers feel when seeing the smiles of the elderly?
options: Feeling that their hard work is very meaningful
qs.why: 感到所有付出都充满意义 (feeling that all efforts are full of meaning).

rzh0032.title: 中国书法的魅力 (The Charm of Chinese Calligraphy)

qs.stem: What are the "Four Treasures of the Study" (Wen Fang Si Bao)?
options: Brush, ink, Xuan paper, and inkstone
qs.why: 毛笔、墨汁、宣纸和砚台 (Brush, ink, Xuan paper, and inkstone).

qs.stem: Which master of cursive script (Xingshu) is mentioned in the text?
qs.why: 王羲之的行书 (Wang Xizhi's Xingshu style).

qs.stem: How does calligraphy express the artist's emotions?
options: Through the thickness, speed, and density of the brushstrokes
qs.why: 借由笔画的轻重缓急、浓淡干湿 (Through the weight, speed, and moisture of the brushstrokes).

rzh0033.title: 学会倾听的力量 (The Power of Listening)

qs.stem: What percentage of time do effective communicators spend listening?
qs.why: 百分之七十的时间都在专注倾听 (70% of the time is spent focused on listening).

qs.stem: What is the main benefit of listening with empathy and respect?
options: Resolving conflicts and building solid trust
qs.why: 化解矛盾分歧，建立深厚持久的信任关系 (Resolving conflicts and building lasting trust).

qs.stem: According to the text, what is a common communication mistake?
options: Rushing to express one's own opinion while ignoring the other party
qs.why: 急于表达自己的观点，而忽略了倾听对方心声 (Rushing to express oneself while ignoring the other's voice).

rzh0034.title: 数字经济与就业变革 (Digital Economy & Employment Transformation)

qs.stem: What cutting-edge technologies are the core engines driving the digital economy?
options: Cloud computing, AI, and Big Data
qs.why: 云计算、人工智能以及大数据技术 (Cloud computing, AI, and Big Data).

qs.stem: What new professions have emerged due to the transformation of smart industries?
qs.why: 算法工程师、数字化管理师 (Algorithm engineers, digitalization managers).

qs.stem: What is the main challenge faced by the workforce in this era?
options: Reconstruction and upgrading of digital skills
qs.why: 对劳动力市场的数字技能重构提出了前所未有的严峻挑战 (The severe challenge of reconstructing digital skills in the labor market).

rzh0035.title: 深空探测与月球背面揭秘 (Deep Space Exploration & Unveiling the Far Side of the Moon)

qs.stem: What historic achievement was recorded by the Chang'e-4 probe?
options: Humanity's first soft landing on the far side of the Moon
Building a space station on Jupiter
qs.why: 首次在月球背面实现人类历史上的首次软着陆 (The first soft landing in human history on the far side of the moon).

qs.stem: Why can't communication signals from the far side of the Moon reach Earth directly?
options: Because they are blocked by Jupiter's atmosphere
Because they are completely blocked by the mass of the Moon itself
Because radio signals are prohibited by the UN
Because the lunar temperature is too cold
qs.why: 月球背面始终背对地球，通信信号会被月体完全遮挡 (The far side of the moon always faces away from Earth, blocking signals).

qs.stem: What relay satellite bridges data communication between Chang'e-4 and the Earth station?
qs.why: “鹊桥”中继卫星 (Queqiao relay satellite).

rzh0036.title: 道法自然与现代生态伦理 (Dao Follows Nature & Modern Ecological Ethics)

qs.stem: What is the core meaning of the teaching "Dao Fa Zi Ran" according to the quote above?
options: Humans must conquer nature by any means
Human activities must respect and align with the laws of nature
Humans are forbidden from using any technology
Nature must submit to human will
qs.why: 人类活动必须敬畏自然规律，摒弃肆意掠夺 (Respect natural laws, abandon reckless exploitation).

qs.stem: Which classical Chinese work contains this philosophical concept?
qs.why: 老子在《道德经》中提出 (Laozi proposed in Dao De Jing).

qs.stem: What is the relevance of this teaching to the modern world as a reference for?
qs.why: 应对气候危机与构建可持续发展 (Addressing the climate crisis and building sustainable development).

rzh0037.title: 心流体验与创造力释放 (Flow Experience & Creativity Release)

qs.stem: What condition is a prerequisite for achieving the "Flow" (心流) state?
options: High level of boredom without tasks
Optimal balance between task challenge and personal skill capacity
Being given a large cash reward
qs.why: 挑战与技能高度匹配 (High match between challenge and skill).

qs.stem: What perceptual phenomenon is frequently experienced by someone when in Flow?
options: Time perception changes/distorts (feels like it passes quickly)
qs.why: 时间知觉往往发生变形 (Time perception often undergoes distortion).

qs.stem: Why is Flow very valuable for contemporary intellectual workers?
options: Being able to sleep during working hours
Helping break through cognitive bottlenecks and overcome anxiety
qs.why: 突破认知瓶颈，破除焦虑 (Break through cognitive bottlenecks, eliminate anxiety).

rzh0038.title: 老龄化社会与银发经济 (Aging Society & Silver Economy)

qs.stem: What is the main trigger for the formation of a society with an aging population structure?
options: Life expectancy increasing and birth rates decreasing
qs.why: 人均预期寿命延长与生育率持续走低 (Extended per capita life expectancy and continuously declining fertility rates).

qs.stem: What industrial sector is growing rapidly in the "Silver Economy" (银发经济)?
options: Elderly-friendly home modifications, wellness tourism, and smart medical monitors
qs.why: 适老家居改造、康养旅居、健康智能监测 (Elderly-friendly home modifications, health tourism, smart health monitoring).

qs.stem: What is the main challenge faced by the state treasury due to population aging?
options: Burden of health insurance expenditure and pension funds
qs.why: 医疗保障和养老金体系带来收支压力 (Bringing revenue and expenditure pressure to medical security and pension systems).

rzh0039.title: 传统榫卯结构的智慧 (Wisdom of Traditional Mortise-and-Tenon Structures)

qs.stem: What is the main characteristic of traditional wooden construction with Sunmao (榫卯) structure?
options: Without using a single iron nail, relying solely on male-female wood joints
qs.why: 不用一颗铁钉，仅凭凹凸相嵌的木构件咬合 (Without a single iron nail, relying solely on the interlocking of mortise and tenon wooden components).

qs.stem: How does this flexible structure respond to high-magnitude earthquakes?
options: Absorbs seismic energy through micro-friction and joint flexibility
qs.why: 通过微幅滑移和摩擦损耗消散大部分地震波能量 (Absorbs most seismic wave energy through micro-slip and frictional loss).

qs.stem: What philosophical mechanics principle is reflected in this architectural masterpiece?
options: Overcoming rigidity with flexibility (以柔克刚)
qs.why: 完美诠释了“以柔克刚”的工程力学智慧 (Perfect interpretation of the engineering mechanics wisdom of "overcoming rigidity with flexibility").

rzh0040.title: 短视频浪潮下的碎片化阅读 (Fragmented Reading in the Wave of Short Videos)

qs.stem: What psychological impact is caused by continuous short video consumption?
options: Attention span is truncated and critical thinking ability is weakened
qs.why: 注意力集中时长大幅压缩，削短长篇逻辑思辨能力 (Attention span is drastically compressed, weakening long-form logical reasoning ability).

qs.stem: What brain chemical is instantly triggered by short video content?
qs.why: 即时的多巴胺奖赏 (Instant dopamine reward).

qs.stem: What solution does the author suggest to maintain individual mental independence?
options: Fighting algorithmic entrapment and re-accustoming to deep reading
qs.why: 对抗算法操控、重拾深阅读习惯 (Fight algorithmic manipulation and regain deep reading habits).

rzh0041.title: 鲁迅与《狂人日记》的启蒙呼喊 (Lu Xun and the Enlightenment Cry of "A Madman's Diary")

qs.stem: What work is recognized as China's first modern vernacular short story?
qs.why: 第一篇现代白话文小说《狂人日记》 (The first modern vernacular novel "A Madman's Diary").

qs.stem: What is the core of the social critique raised by Lu Xun in this novel?
options: Dismantling the hypocrisy of ancient feudal norms that suppress humanity
qs.why: 揭露了封建礼教“吃人”的虚伪本质 (Exposing the hypocritical essence of feudal ritual teachings "eating people").

qs.stem: What iconic concluding sentence became the moral cry of the intellectual generation of that era?
qs.why: 结尾振聋发聩的“救救孩子……” (The deafening ending: "Save the children...").

rzh0042.title: 汉字演变与中华文明基因 (Evolution of Chinese Characters & the Genetic Code of Chinese Civilization)

qs.stem: What is the main uniqueness of Chinese characters compared to other phonetic scripts in the world?
options: The only continuous ideographic writing system without interruption for thousands of years
Can only be written on stone
qs.why: 唯一未曾中断、连续使用数千年的表意文字体系 (The only ideographic writing system that has never been interrupted and has been used continuously for thousands of years).

qs.stem: What is the correct chronological order of the typographical development of Chinese characters?
options: Oracle Bone Script (Jiaguwen) -> Jinwen -> Zhuan -> Lishu -> Kaishu
qs.why: 甲骨文、金文、大篆、小篆、隶书到楷书 (Oracle bone script, bronze script, large seal, small seal, clerical script to regular script).

qs.stem: Why are Chinese characters able to unite communities with different dialects?
options: Because everyone is required to be mute
Due to the cross-dialect ideographic nature using a unified written language
Because dialects are banned by the emperor
Because Chinese characters only have 10 letters
qs.why: 具备超方言、超地域的跨时空凝聚力，统一书面语 (Possessing cross-dialect, cross-regional cohesion across time and space, unifying the written language).

rzh0043.title: 三星堆遗址与古蜀文明迷思 (Sanxingdui Ruins & Myths of the Ancient Shu Civilization)

qs.stem: What spectacular bronze artifacts were discovered at the Sanxingdui site?
options: Prominent-eyed bronze mask & bronze divine tree
qs.why: 造型奇绝的青铜纵目大面具、青铜神树 (Prominent-eyed bronze mask & bronze divine tree).

qs.stem: The Sanxingdui discovery revised the historical paradigm of Chinese civilization into what?
options: A unified diverse pattern (多元一体 - Multi-origin unity)
Originating purely from the European mainland
qs.why: 有力印证了中华文明“多元一体”格局 (Proves the "pluralistic and integrated" pattern).

qs.stem: In which province is the Sanxingdui site located?
qs.why: 四川广汉三星堆遗址 (Sanxingdui site in Guanghan, Sichuan).

rzh0044.title: 通用人工智能时代的认知边界 (Cognitive Boundaries in the Age of AGI)

qs.stem: What is the basic processing mechanism of current large language models?
options: Statistical probability prediction of the next token
Reading human thoughts via brain waves
qs.why: 基于统计概率预测下一个标记（Token）的归纳推理机制 (Statistical probability prediction of the next token).

qs.stem: What classic thought experiment is often raised to test AI's true understanding of meaning?
qs.why: “塞尔中文屋思想实验” (Searle's Chinese Room Argument).

qs.stem: What cognitive quality is still questioned as to whether a machine can possess it?
options: True causal reasoning, subjective consciousness, and moral intuition
qs.why: 因果推理、意识体验与道德直觉 (True causality, consciousness, moral intuition).

rzh0045.title: 丝绸之路的千年回响 (Millennial Echoes of the Silk Road)

qs.stem: Who was the pioneering figure of Western Han diplomacy who opened the Silk Road?
qs.why: 自西汉张骞“凿空”西域以降 (Since Zhang Qian pioneered the Western Regions).

qs.stem: What commodities and technologies from China spread to the west?
qs.why: 丝绸、瓷器、造纸术的西渐 (Silk, porcelain, and papermaking techniques).

qs.stem: What historical lesson is relevant to today's global geopolitics?
options: Rejecting the clash of civilizations thesis through peaceful & inclusive cooperation
All countries should close their borders
Trade should only be conducted via the sea
qs.why: 破除“文明冲突论”，和平合作开放包容 (Dispelling the clash of civilizations through peaceful cooperation).

rzh0046.title: 青藏高原的生态屏障功能 (Ecological Barrier Function of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau)

qs.stem: What is the prestigious geographical nickname for the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau?
options: The Third Pole (第三极) and the Water Tower of Asia (亚洲水塔)
qs.why: “第三极”和“亚洲水塔” (The Third Pole and the Water Tower of Asia).

qs.stem: What is the most severe environmental threat facing this fragile plateau ecosystem?
options: Climate warming melting glaciers and degrading permafrost
qs.why: 气候暖化正在加速冰川消融与冻土退化 (Melting glaciers and permafrost degradation).

qs.stem: What strategic conservation steps have been taken to protect the region?
options: Establishing Sanjiangyuan National Park with strict red lines
qs.why: 建立三江源国家公园等机制化保护红线 (Establishing Sanjiangyuan National Park).

rzh0047.title: 网络巴尔干化与信息茧房 (Cyberbalkanization & Information Cocoon)

qs.stem: What are the sociological consequences of the "Information Cocoon" (信息茧房) trap?
options: Society becomes increasingly harmonious and tolerant
Group opinion polarization, reinforcement of bias, and the fading of rational dialogue
qs.why: 同质化观点强化群体极化与认知偏见，削弱共识 (Group polarization and reinforcement of bias).

qs.stem: What term is used to describe the fragmentation of the internet into isolated camps?
qs.why: 网络巴尔干化 (Cyberbalkanization).

qs.stem: What solution does the author propose to overcome this phenomenon?
options: Shutting down the entire global internet network
Cultivating algorithmic literacy, critical empathy, and exposure to diverse perspectives
Banning the use of computers for young people
qs.why: 培养算法素养、批判性同理心与引入异质视角 (Algorithmic literacy & critical empathy).

rzh0048.title: 神经可塑性与认知重构 (Neuroplasticity & Cognitive Restructuring)

qs.stem: What revolutionary finding does modern neurobiology prove regarding the adult brain?
options: The brain stops developing at age 12
The brain possesses lifelong neural plasticity to restructure its networks
The brain does not require oxygen
qs.why: 确证大脑在终其一生都具备显著的“神经可塑性” (Lifelong neuroplasticity).

qs.stem: What activities are capable of stimulating the formation of new neural synapses?
options: Learning a new language, practicing musical instruments, and repetitive stimulation
Sleeping 20 hours a day without thinking
Sitting daydreaming in a dark room
qs.why: 学习新语言、掌握乐器指法、针对性重复刺激 (Language learning, musical instruments, stimulation).

qs.stem: What is the fundamental meaning of the concept of "Neuroplasticity" for human potential?
options: Human mental and cognitive potential can always be reconstructed
The human brain is identical to an iron computer machine
Past memories will be completely erased
qs.why: 证明了人类心智永不停歇的重构潜能 (Incessant cognitive restructuring potential).

rzh0049.title: 意境与留白的东方美学品格 (The Concepts of Yijing & Liubai in Eastern Aesthetics)

qs.stem: What is the meaning of the "Liubai" (留白 - negative space) technique in Chinese landscape painting?
options: Negative space signifies the flow of energy and boundless poetic imagination
The paper is not yet finished being drawn
qs.why: 非空无一物，而是气韵流转、万象蕴藉的虚灵之府 (Flow of energy & poetic imagination).

qs.stem: What is the highest spiritual achievement attained by art connoisseurs through "Yijing" (意境)?
options: Harmonious unity between human and nature (天人合一)
Being able to sell paintings at high prices
qs.why: 达致天人合一的高妙精神境界 (Achieving the spiritual state of Man and Nature in Harmony).

qs.stem: Which prominent Chinese aesthetician is referenced in the paragraph?
qs.why: 在宗白华先生的美学论述中 (In the aesthetic discourse of Zong Baihua).
